> little-tide@1.0.0 build
> mkdir -p dist && cp index.html styles.css game.js dist/

Little Tide is ready to play. The game already had its core loop in place, so I verified it end to end rather than changing the design: catching fish, recruiting an otter, autosaving, the WebGL scene, and the mobile layout all worked without browser errors.

**Verified:** `node --check game.js`, `npm run build`, desktop and mobile browser checks. Run locally with `npm run dev`, then open `http://localhost:3002` as noted in the README. I assumed the existing cozy fishing-clicker concept and kept its current design.
